scope: English development screening before candidate output is viewed

smallEngineScreen.criticalTokenSymmetricDifference: no greater than the maximum same-configuration double-run null
smallEngineScreen.rawLineDifferences: no greater than the maximum same-configuration double-run null
smallEngineScreen.batchCompanionRule: each page stays inside the same derived null under B1/C1 and B8/C8
smallEngineScreen.boxRule: report every unmatched box and exact-text matched-box IoU; no silent thresholding
smallEngineScreen.confidenceRule: report maximum and distribution of shifts; no routing decision may change without review

tinyScreen.rule: speed can advance Tiny to development scoring but cannot adopt it
tinyScreen.adoption: requires the complete section 13.2 ceremony and one sealed English holdout evaluation
